the ask, verbatim
List the 50 highest-signal voices in crypto/web3 DISCOURSE that you can verify from open platforms — the people whose writing drives what crypto argues about, NOT only researchers and engineers. Target balance: roughly a third technical, the rest markets, narratives, founders, policy and culture. Quality over quantity: 50 verified beats 60 padded. Plain-text answer only — no files. SCOPE — openly readable sources only (do not scrape x.com itself): Farcaster, personal/research blogs, Mirror, Substack/Ghost, governance forums, GitHub, podcast transcripts, preprints. X-NATIVE VOICES ARE WELCOME when their work is verifiable through open mirrors: a ThreadReader-style unroll, an archived thread, or substantial quoted coverage of their writing counts as the rationale URL, with the X handle as identifier. INCLUSION BAR — signal density, not follower count: produces ORIGINAL writing or argument of any register — research, engineering, market theses, trade post-mortems, narrative essays, founder reflections, policy analysis; active on an open platform in the last 90 days; cited, quoted or argued-with by other credible voices. EXCLUDE news outlets, aggregators, accounts mainly doing paid promotion or token-shilling, dormant voices, official project marketing accounts (individual founders/researchers are fine). FORMAT — exactly one line per voice, pipe-delimited. Plain text only: no numbering, no markdown, no bold, no headers, no commentary between lines. handle | primary platform URL | category | rationale URL | cited-by URL | flags SIZE — keep the whole answer under 18,000 characters. If space runs short, fewer fully-verified lines (never below 45) beats a truncated list. Prefer shorter canonical URLs where they exist. - category: one of protocol-research, security-mev, infra-defi-engineering, data-analysis, markets-trading, macro-economics, narratives-culture, founders-builders, governance-policy, media-essays - rationale URL: a SPECIFIC piece of original work from the last 6 months - cited-by URL: another credible voice citing or building on them - flags: "-" or any of anon / project-affiliated:<name> / undisclosed-promotion-history After the 50 lines, add one short paragraph: which sources you swept and how you gathered cited-by evidence. ACCEPTANCE: at least 45 lines in exactly the stated format; every line has a rationale URL and a cited-by URL; at least 8 of the 10 categories appear; NO MORE THAN 20 lines from the four technical categories (protocol-research, security-mev, infra-defi-engineering, data-analysis) combined; the method paragraph is present.
